title: Fix TypeScript Errors in Compose JS and Elements UI
description: Fix TypeScript compilation errors in compose/js/index.ts and elements/ui/index.tsx. The errors include: missing arguments in function calls, wrong property names (definition vs attributes), type incompatibilities with Plane/ArrayBuffer, spread types on unknown, and DraggableAttributes type mismatches.
summary: Fixed 7 TypeScript compilation errors across compose/js/index.ts and elements/ui/index.tsx. Cast PlaneDiff to Plane in deletePiecesAndConnectionsInDesign. Added missing kit argument. Removed non-existent definition and attributes fields from hash functions. Fixed Uint8Array generic. Cast slot to ReactElement. Widened TreeDragHandle attributes prop. tsc passes clean, all 134 tests pass, dev server running.
